txt_en: Sometimes you have to travel a long way to find what is near.
txt_cn: 有时候，要走很远才能发现，是什么一直陪伴在身边。
author: Paulo Coelho

txt_en: We love the things we love for what they are.
txt_cn: 我们热爱那些事物，是因为热爱它们原本的样子。
author: Robert Frost

txt_en: One of the most important things you can do on this earth is to let people know they are not alone.
txt_cn: 在这个世界上，你所能做的最重要的事情之一，就是让别人知道他们并不孤单。
author: Shannon L. Alder

txt_en: The greatest pleasure I know is to do a good action by stealth, and to have it found out by accident.
txt_cn: 我所知的最大乐趣是，暗中行善举，但又偶然间为人所知。
author: Charles Lamb

txt_en: If opportunity doesn't knock, build a door.
txt_cn: 如果机会没有来敲门，那就自己盖个门。
author: Milton Berle

txt_en: You cannot explore the universe if you think that you are the center of it.
txt_cn: 若把自己当作宇宙的中心，就无法对宇宙进行探索。
author: Joshua Suya Pelicano

txt_en: You have to have confidence in your ability, and then be tough enough to follow through.
txt_cn: 你要对自己的能力有信心，然后保持坚强、坚持到底。
author: Rosalynn Carter

txt_en: It is said the feeling called happiness cannot be known alone.
txt_cn: 听说，有种叫幸福的感觉无法独享。
author: Aleskei Arbusov

txt_en: It is better to fail in originality than to succeed in imitation.
txt_cn: 宁可在创新中失败，也不要在模仿中成功。
author: Herman Melville

txt_en: Change your thoughts and you change your world.
txt_cn: 改变你的想法，就是改变了你的世界。
author: Norman Vincent Peale

txt_en: It is difficult to free fools from the chains they revere.
txt_cn: 很难使傻瓜摆脱他们所崇尚的束缚。
author: Voltaire

txt_en: Only those who risk going too far can possibly find out how far they can go.
txt_cn: 唯有那些敢于冒险大步向前的人，才能够了解自己能走多远。
author: T. S. Eliot

txt_en: When two people love each other, they don't look at each other, they look in the same direction.
txt_cn: 两人相爱时，他们不会对视，而是会看向同一个方向。
author: Ginger Rogers

txt_en: Sports teaches you character, it teaches you to play by the rules, it teaches you to know what it feels like to win and lose — it teaches you about life.
txt_cn: 体育塑造你的性格，教会你遵守规则，让你体会输赢——它教会你生活。
author: Billie Jean King

txt_en: Don't compare your life to others. You have no idea what they have been through.
txt_cn: 不要和别人比生活，你不知道他们经历了什么。
author: Sam Cawthorn

txt_en: Always be a first-rate version of yourself, instead of a second-rate version of somebody else.
txt_cn: 永远要做第一流的自己，而不是第二流的他人。
author: Judy Garland

txt_en: Hard work beats talent when talent fails to work hard.
txt_cn: 有天分却不努力，就会被努力的人击败。
author: 凯文·杜兰特

txt_en: Optimism is the one quality more associated with success and happiness than any other.
txt_cn: 与其他品质相比，乐观更能让你获得成功和幸福。
author: Brian Tracy

txt_en: Definiteness of purpose is the starting point of all achievement.
txt_cn: 目标明确是一切成功的起点。
author: W. Clement Stone

txt_en: To be what we are, and to become what we are capable of becoming, is the only end of life.
txt_cn: 做我们自己，并成为我们所能成为的人，是人生唯一的目的。
author: Robert Louis Stevenson

txt_en: Good manners and soft words have brought many a difficult thing to pass.
txt_cn: 礼貌的行为和温柔的话语会让很多难题迎刃而解。
author: Sir John Vanbrugh
